subject: Initial buyer intake: bank proof, remit authorization, and PO mapping
content:

Cc: vendor-support@acmepay.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — bank details + PO preferences

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — Bluebox Labs is ready to start. We need to be set up as a vendor in your system so POs can be routed and payments issued. Can you confirm what you need from us for both ACH and wire (bank letter, account routing, beneficiary name), and whether Redwood requires a specific PO format or a Purchase Order prefix to link invoices back to POs?

Also: who should we address for tax forms and remit-to (billing@blueboxlabs.com or finance@blueboxlabs.com)? Happy to attach the W-9 and a bank letter once I have the checklist.

Thanks,
Jordan Reeves

Bluebox Labs
[jordan.mobile:+1-415-555-0182]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — bank details + PO preferences

Hi Jordan — welcome, and great to meet you (virtually).

Short checklist from procurement to get Bluebox fully live for PO and payments:
- Completed buyer intake form (attached template) — legal entity name, EIN/Tax ID, registration address.
- Tax documentation: W-9 (US entity) or W-8BEN-E for non-US.
- Banking proof: bank letter on bank letterhead OR recent bank statement with account holder name + last 4 digits.
- Remit-to email and contact (this is where remittance advices are sent).
- ACH details: bank name, routing number, account number, account type, ACH authorization document.
- Wire details: SWIFT/BIC, IBAN (if applicable), intermediary bank instructions.
- Invoice requirements: invoice email and PO number field; Redwood prefers "PO-XXXX-YYYY" prefix so invoices auto-match.

Attached are: buyer_intake_template.xlsx and payment-authorization-form.xlsx (fill and return).

Once you send W-9 + bank letter, I will open the vendor record and route to Finance (cc Marcus) for verification and payment terms setup. Typical SLAs: vendor created in 2–3 business days after Finance verifies docs; ACH mandates are onboarded within one weekly run.

Questions: do you require PO validation at invoice receipt (we currently enforce matching PO number + line items)? Any special GL mapping requests?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0134
